description: RJ-60 is an active RTO series introduced in May 2023 for the Jaipur region to alleviate the registration load on the existing RJ-14 and RJ-45 series. It primarily serves private vehicle registrations in the western and suburban parts of Jaipur city and operates under the jurisdiction of the Jaipur (RTO-I) office.
address: Regional Transport Office, Jhalana Institutional Area, Jaipur, Rajasthan
